page.layout: One page of running text; two notes in the left margin, beside the first and fourth paragraphs; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Vbiquitas ex male explicata Consubstantiatione in Ecclesiam sensim irrepsit.Sed aliter Opt.Max.Deo visum est, patefa-ctæ Euangelicæ suæ veritatis contemptum, & hominum gratuitam peccatorum remis-sionem a vera & seria resipiscentia separantium impuritatem iustissimè vlcisenti: donec tandem, ad vbiquitatem vsque progressa est, vtrinque disputatium fatalis intemperies.

Quibus autem illa gradibus emerserit, etsi mihi nunc propositum non est explicare, ne tantorum malorum memoriam renouare videar, cuius potius ἀμνηστίαν[?] malim meo ipsius sanguine redimere: tamen reticere nequeo, mirum mihi non videri, quòd aliquot demum post paroxismum illum priorem annis Vbiquitas ista irruperit: sed mirari me potius cur non statim emerserit. Quod enim tandem mecum iudicaturos spero, quicunque sine praeiudicio, & sedatioribus animis, quid ex quo necessario consequatur secum expenderint: nec essentialis & realis illa per indistantiam praesentia, nec oralis tum signorum tum ipsius Christi eius & potus, siue Transsub-stantiatione siue Consubstantiatione posita, stare absque illa Vbiquitate poterit.

Transsubstantiatores damnant Vbiquitatem, sed alibi naufragium faciunt.Et hæc quidem vsque adeo non latuerunt scholasticos Doctores illorum temporum, minimè profectò obtusi ingenij plerosque, vt memores iampridem aduersus Eutychianos, Monothelitas, Monophysitas gestorum, hanc ipsam Vbiquitatem passim iugularint. Sed iidem, sic tum ferete Spiritus erroris effi-cacia, & illo tunc regnante Transsubstantia-

page.notes: The left margin notes are printed in small italic type; the first runs over two lines with hyphenated breaks, the second is set in the margin beside the fourth paragraph. "naufragiu" in the second note is uncertain as to its final abbreviation mark. The Greek word in the text ("ἀμνηστίαν") is hard to read at this resolution and is marked [?]. The catchword "tionis" sits at the lower right below the last line. The scan is slightly skewed at the top right, and some lines near the right edge are faint.
